mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT seq as "SEQ", broadcast_date as "BROADCAST_DATE", broadcast_status as "BROADCAST_STATUS", live_auction_seq as "LIVE_AUCTION_SEQ" FROM live_auction_schedule WHERE broadcast_status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY broadcast_status DESC, broadcast_date ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT l.seq, l.name, l.bid_open_price as bidOpenPrice, l.image, l.description, l.create_member_seq as createMemberSeq, l.category_seq as categorySeq, c.name as categoryName, m.id as sellerId FROM live_auction l LEFT OUTER JOIN category c ON l.category_seq = c.seq INNER JOIN member m ON l.create_member_seq = m.seq WHERE l.seq = #{seq}

SELECT l.seq, l.name, l.bid_open_price AS bidOpenPrice, l.image, l.description, l.create_member_seq AS createMemberSeq, l.category_seq AS categorySeq, c.name AS categoryName, m_seller.id AS sellerId, h.highestBid, h.member_seq AS highestBidMemberSeq, m_bidder.id AS highestBidUserId FROM live_auction l LEFT JOIN category c ON l.category_seq = c.seq INNER JOIN member m_seller ON l.create_member_seq = m_seller.seq LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT live_auction_seq, bid_price AS highestBid, member_seq, bid_time FROM live_bid_history WHERE live_auction_seq = #{seq} AND status = 0 ORDER BY bid_price DESC, bid_time ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) h ON l.seq = h.live_auction_seq LEFT JOIN member m_bidder ON h.member_seq = m_bidder.seq WHERE l.seq = #{seq}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT seq, bid_price as bidPrice, bid_time as bidTime, status FROM live_bid_history WHERE live_auction_seq = #{seq} AND member_seq = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY bid_price DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: update live_bid_history set status = 1 where live_auction_seq = #{seq} and status = 0
mapper.insert: insert into live_bid_history (seq, bid_price, bid_time, status, member_seq, live_auction_seq) values (live_bid_history_seq.nextVal, #{bidPrice}, default, 0, #{memberSeq}, #{seq})
mapper.select: SELECT b.seq, b.live_auction_seq, b.member_seq, b.bid_price, b.bid_time, b.status, m.id AS userId FROM live_bid_history b INNER JOIN member m ON b.member_seq = m.seq WHERE b.live_auction_seq = #{_parameter} ORDER BY b.bid_time DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT m.point - NVL(( SELECT SUM(amount) FROM point_lock WHERE member_seq = m.seq AND status = 0 ), 0) FROM member m WHERE m.seq = #{memberSeq}
